content.short: DataHive AI pays people for contributing browsing data, photos and video that are packaged into AI training datasets.
content.description: DataHive runs a two-sided data market. Contributors install a Chrome extension or mobile app and share browsing data, photos and short clips, earning points and DATA token rewards based on how their data is used. On the other side, AI developers buy curated datasets for text, images, video and audio in areas like e-commerce, speech and reviews. Its catalogue includes specialised sets such as multi-dialect Arabic emotional speech recordings and verified e-commerce product listings, and the platform also lets users stake SOL.
content.meta: Earn rewards by contributing data that DataHive packages into datasets for AI training. Explore DataHive AI on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
